static_traits.name: Lin Peiqi
static_traits.family_status: Proud of the nephew and takes on the responsibility of caring for him
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends,but has not yet shared this specific problem with them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar issues;has not yet received psychotherapy;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,able to describe problems and impacts specifically;negative attitude,marked Self-denial;tends to speculate about others' thoughts and avoid feedback;fairly cooperative,willing to try communicating with nephew

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt I am a terrible Chef,because my nephew often cannot finish when I cook Italian food;this sense of inadequacy and Continuing self-doubt for months,plus the pressure of the final year as a Graduate student and caring for my nephew,makes me feel Anxiety and unease when cooking for my nephew,affecting sleep,relationships and studies.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling,because this sense of inadequacy is affecting my enjoyment of cooking and causing Increased stress.

special_situations.event: My nephew often cannot finish when I cook Italian food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he really liked my cooking,he would finish it;his not finishing means my cooking is terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly revising recipes,seeking comfort and affirmation from family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault,I am a bad Chef

special_situations.event: Seeing my nephew seem somewhat not interested in the food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any sign of disinterest means he does not like my cooking
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on negative cues, ignoring family's positive evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He does not like the food I cook

special_situations.event: Thinks about communicating with a nephew or other family members to understand the reasons
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Asking will surely bring negative feedback,thus proving I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking with nephew / family about true feelings and specific reasons
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think my food is not good,and will criticize me

special_situations.event: Cooking for him under the pressure of balancing Graduate student studies and caring for my nephew
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do both studies and caring for my nephew perfectly,it means I am terrible at everything
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressuring myself,constantly adjusting recipes to prove myself

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked and accepted through cooking, to build a warm connection with the nephew
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated and rejected,worrying that not being good enough will cost the closeness of the relationship
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of criticism through Self-denial and avoiding feedback,maintaining surface-level security

object_relations.self_representation: Guilt,an 'incompetent caregiver/terrible Chef' worried about being negated
object_relations.object_representation: Picky 'care recipient(nephew)' who may not approve of oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate with the nephew or family and collect real feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Imagining possibly neutral or positive feedback as criticism,believing others will negate her cooking(transference-based speculation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone,avoiding specific feedback requests,use vague expressions(such as 'maybe he is just a picky eater'),emphasizing uncertainty and expressing nervousness,not directly Questioning for now.

manifestations: Cooking shifting from 'relaxation and expressing love' to a 'source of Anxiety'
Decreased sense of connection with nephew,cooking no longer brings satisfaction

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial('I am a bad Chef')
Overly concerned about possible negative evaluations
High tension and insecurity before and after cooking

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Knowing one could ask the nephew for the reason yet choosing to repress the impulse and avoid communicating
Not yet sharing this problem with supportive friends and bearing the pressure alone
Turning the need for external feedback into self-blame and internal drain

positive_force: Passionate about cooking, willing to express love through food
Willing to try asking the nephew the reason in a relaxed way (open to reality testing)
Has a supportive network of friends
negative_force: Self-denial and excessive attribution to oneself(personalization)
Cognitive biases such as jumping to conclusions, overgeneralization, and mental filtering
Avoiding communication for fear of negative feedback, excessively caring about others' evaluations
Overlapping academic and caregiving pressures leading to Anxiety and Sleep affected

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Anxiety and insecurity when cooking for nephew
antecedent: Situations where the nephew cannot finish or seems not very interested
Coexisting pressures of Graduate student studies and caring for nephew
target_behavior.core_reason: Attributing the nephew's not finishing food to one's own poor cooking,accompanied by personalization,jumping to conclusions and overgeneralization biases
target_behavior.function: Escaping the risk of being negated and Being rejected,trying to maintain control and the psychological safety of 'preventing failure' through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Loss of pleasure in cooking,Relationship tension with nephew,Sleep affected,academic performance under pressure

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding direct communication and feedback with the nephew/family
antecedent: When thinking of asking the nephew why he did not finish
Situations of fearing negative evaluation or criticism
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by fear of being negated and shame,and by projective speculation about others' thoughts
target_behavior.function: Temporarily relieving Anxiety,avoiding discomfort and potential conflict
target_behavior.consequence: The problem persists,misunderstandings deepen,Anxiety is maintained and may worsen
